image.why: Raphael's Aristotle holding his Ethics, the most familiar Renaissance image of the philosopher

summary.en: Greek philosopher, pupil of Plato and tutor of Alexander the Great. To medieval scholars he was simply "the Philosopher", the authority on logic, nature and ethics.

en: His works reached the Latin West largely through 12th–13th-century translations
Thomas Aquinas built much of his theology on Aristotle's philosophy
